visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) In a dimly lit indoor circus arena, a performer in a blue and pink outfit walks a brown horse across a red circular mat while a large spherical metal cage stands in the background. (2) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a strapless silver top, speaks directly to the camera while sitting in a red theater seat amidst a crowd. (3) She stands in a brightly lit convenience store aisle filled with colorful bottled drinks, holding two bags of snacks and gesturing with her finger. (4) The scene shifts outdoors to a grassy farm area with a wooden shack; she kneels to feed long blades of grass to a black and white goat. (5) She enters a rustic wooden stable labeled '第一馬廄' (First Stable), holding grass and spinning around to show the environment. (6) She stands by a wooden stall feeding grass to a small dark pony named '500' while smiling. (7) She introduces a large white horse in a separate stall, gesturing towards it in the wooden barn. (8) Transitioning back to the circus exterior, she stands before a red and blue striped tent under bright lights, gesturing excitedly. (9) A montage of circus acts follows: a performer in white hanging from aerial silks, another spinning in a hoop, and two acrobats performing handstands on high poles under purple and red lights. (10) An equestrian act features a rider standing atop two galloping horses in the arena. (11) The woman reacts with high energy from the audience, clapping and cheering. (12) Finally, she is on the arena floor high-fiving a group of international performers holding various national flags, ending with a wide-armed pose in front of the spherical cage.
